title: One-step return-state simulation
statement: Let $M$ be a machine with $m$ work tapes, embed those tape indices into $k$ work tapes, and let $c$ be an $m$-tape configuration whose state is not halted. For any initial contents and head positions on the other tapes and any output prefix, one step of the simulation with a distinguished return state, from the embedded configuration with states renamed into the left summand, equals the embedded configuration obtained after one step of $M$, with its state changed to the left summand when it remains active and to the distinguished right-summand state when it halts.
hypotheses_covered: An embedding of the $m$ work-tape indices into the $k$ work-tape indices
The state of $c$ is not halted
Initial tape contents and head positions on the $k$ tapes
